text:
emily: Uploaded staging package for orion-xl v1 to s3://redwood-staging/models/orion-xl/v1 — safetensors shards + tokenizer. Need quick checks on weights paths, shard_map, TP layout, and dtype before we promote to canary. pinging @sasha @anil for tokenizer/shard checks and @jay for runtime layout/serve smoke.

infra-bot: upload complete — 8 files, total 24.3GB. manifest.json written. checksum: ok for shards 0,1,4,5. (automated)

anil: quick heads-up — tokenizer.json shows "vocab_size": 50260 but the tokenizer files on disk look like 50257 tokens. mismatch might break embedding lookup. run: `rcli inspect-tokenizer s3://redwood-staging/models/orion-xl/v1/tokenizer.json` to repro.

sasha: saw that too. Also tokenizer_config has `bos_token` set to the token string rather than the token id; runtime expects `<s>` literal. Suggest adding a small mapping in tokenizer_config.json to be explicit.

jay: looking at the shard filenames: model_tp0_rank0.safetensors ... model_tp0_rank3.safetensors — were these exported with TP=4 or TP=2? manifest says "tensor_parallel": 2 but the script we used set TP=4 earlier. If TP disagrees with shard layout we'll get wrong KV ordering.

emily: I ran `rcli inspect-shards s3://redwood-staging/models/orion-xl/v1/` — it printed `shard_map: [0,2,1,3]` which is wrong for canonical TP=4 row-major. I reuploaded corrected shards 1 and 2 to staging (same keys but with _fixed suffix) while investigating. Please re-check the shard_map and manifest consistency.

anil: I'll validate tokenizer fixes + run a small embedding token test. local command I use:
```
python tools/tokenizer_check.py --model s3://redwood-staging/models/orion-xl/v1 --sample "Hello world"
```
If vocab_size mismatch, it prints the offending tokens/ids.

sasha: suggested config snippet to include in conversion PR (put in manifest override):
```
model_dtype: fp16
inference_dtype: bf16
tensor_parallel: 4
shard_ordering: row-major
tokenizer_special_tokens:
  bos_token: "<s>"
  eos_token: "</s>"
```
Reason: runtime kernels on the nova pool expect bf16 inference path; conversion defaulted to fp16 which changes kernels and numeric path.

emily: good catch — conversion script used `--dtype fp16` by default. I set `inference_dtype` to bf16 in the manifest override so serving will pick right kernels.

jay: I'll take the conversion PR and run a serve-smoke on dev. CR ping: https://git.internal/redwood/convert/pulls/487 — @anil can you add the tokenizer fix commit to that PR? I can review after.

anil: yep will push tokenizer fix + safetensors metadata patch. also found shards 2/3 missing `sha256` metadata tag. running:
```
rcli compute-checksum --shard s3://redwood-staging/models/orion-xl/v1/model_tp0_rank2.safetensors
rcli tag --key sha256 --value <hex> s3://redwood-staging/models/orion-xl/v1/model_tp0_rank2.safetensors
```

sasha: checklist I want green before canary flip:
- tokenizer vocab_size matches tokenizer.json
- tokenizer special tokens canonicalized
- shard_map matches tensor_parallel in manifest
- dtype (model/inference) consistent with kernels
- safetensors shards have checksums and manifest points to them
- permissions/ACLs verified (no public buckets)

emily: updated PR description with that checklist and added links to the staging manifests + where I put the fixed shards. Will wait for @jay + @anil verification. :thumbsup:

jay: ack — starting smoke now, ETA ~45m. I'll post results here.

infra-bot: staging bucket ACLs verified: public=false; IAM roles for deployer service present.

anil: pushed tokenizer fix and checksum tags. Also added a tiny conversion test that asserts `len(vocab) == manifest.tokenizer.vocab_size` in CI.

sasha: nice, CI test should catch regressions. If jay's smoke passes we can move to a canary rollout with auto-fallback to orion-xl-v1-fp16 if anything spikes.

emily: thanks all. I'll avoid flipping traffic until both smoke + shard_map+dtype checks are green. Follow-up: I'll add a short note in the model-onboarding doc about common TP export gotchas.

jay: smoke finished — embeddings and generation sanity ok, latency within SLO on dev (small load). no immediate errors. will rerun with 10x tokens next.

emily: excellent — leaving this here for audit trail. will tag the PR for merge once the 10x run is green. :rocket:
